facility_count_rules: Count a candidate facility only from a source-local facility/approval identifier after source-specific deduplication.
Preserve each GIW activity/species/category/product row as an observation keyed to WNI; do not sum section counts.
GUS, RRW aggregates, ARiMR funding, EIA/planning records and environmental permits are claims/events/overlays, not facility rows.
A missing row is not closure; lifecycle requires source status/date evidence.
Addresses and coordinates remain restricted until privacy and precision review; no geocoding was performed.

next_country_recommendation.reason: FSAI currently exposes a coordinated approved-food landing page with DAFM, HSE and SFPA authority lists, and the HSE page provides a refreshed, structured approval-number/trading-name/address/business-type/activity/species view. This is a strong multi-authority adapter rehearsal, subject to the same privacy, terms and no-double-counting gates.
